# CodeMirror Virtualization Stress Note

This note contains 40 distinct sections spanning over 1,500 lines to verify that Chapter Pipeline correctly tracks headings when early sections are virtualized out of the CodeMirror 6 DOM.

## Section 1: Performance Milestone 1

This is paragraph 1 of section 1 detailing performance metrics and algorithmic complexity.
In virtualized editors like Obsidian CodeMirror 6, nodes far from viewport are pruned from DOM.
Chapter Pipeline must maintain continuous outline tracking via line coordinate mapping.

Paragraph 1 containing extensive contextual content to ensure realistic vertical layout separation. The line padding ensures the CodeMirror editor will virtualize elements outside the active viewport window.
